```python
def seconds(run):
    """The run's own time, as its one-line message says it."""
    t = run.timings()
    return sum(s for stage, s in zip(t["stage"], t["seconds"], strict=True) if stage == "total")


# Each lever against the case as it ships: (the scenario's options, the run's).
levers = {
    "as the case ships it": ({}, {}),
    "a search per pair": ({"route_update_options": {}, "parking_options": {}}, {}),
    "every person simulated": ({"weight": 1}, {}),
    "spillback (flow level 4)": ({"flow_level": 4}, {}),
    "a gap of 2 %": ({"equilibration_options": {"gap_tolerance": 0.02}}, {}),
    "one thread": ({}, {"threads": 1}),
}
rows = []
for city in ("delft", "amsterdam"):
    case = ms.examples.case(city)
    for lever, (options, run_options) in levers.items():
        run = case.scenario("base", **options).run(f"{city}-{len(rows)}", quiet=True, **run_options)
        rows.append({
            "city": city,
            "lever": lever,
            "run (s)": round(seconds(run), 1),
            "loadings": int(max(run.convergence()["iteration"])) + 1,
            "mean trip (min)": round(run.mean_travel_time_s / 60, 2),
            "completed (%)": round(100 * run.completion["completed"] / run.completion["total_trips"], 1),
            "verdict": run.convergence_verdict,
        })
pd.set_option("display.width", 160)  # the whole table on one line per row
pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index(["city", "lever"])
```
